Prior to the [[Battle of Anaxes]], in the final [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[212th Attack Battalion]] and [[501st Legion]] of the [[Republic Military]] undertook an '''assault on Cato Neimoidia'''.<ref name="Grand Army Encyclopedia" /> Also known as a '''campaign on Cato Neimoidia''',<ref name="Chrome Cody">{{HotToysCite|set=Movie Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#734: Commander Cody (Chrome Version)|link=collectibles/star-wars-commander-cody-chrome-version-hot-toys-913142}}</ref> the incident saw [[Jedi General]]s [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] again teaming up<ref name="Anakin Skywalker">{{EncyclopediaCite|Anakin Skywalker}}</ref> as part of the effort to capture the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|leader]], [[Nute Gunray]]. The [[viceroy]]'s [[Nute Gunray's stronghold|stronghold]] in the western hemisphere of the [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]] was marked as the prime target for the attack.<ref name="BMF 31" /> While the campaign nearly ended in disaster,<ref name="Chrome Cody" /> with Gunray indeed escaping capture and instead fleeing into the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]],<ref name="BMF 31" /> the Republic was able to capture his [[mechno-chair]], which gave the Republic's intelligence services important clues about the [[Sith]] behind the war.<ref name="Grand Army Encyclopedia" />

Skywalker claimed to have saved Kenobi's life at some stage of the operation.<ref name="Anakin Skywalker" /> The rescue came as a result of Kenobi encountering a collection of spores, which left him in an intoxicated state. Supposedly, however, the inebriated Kenobi was able to take out fifty [[B2-series super battle droid]]s on his own. After the [[Battle of Coruscant]], Skywalker made reference to a moment where he had saved Kenobi's life on Cato Neimoidia, which Kenobi disagreed with; while the recent battle and the moment in which Kenobi became intoxicated seemed to fit what both were referring to,<ref name="BattleEncyclopedia" /> both were actually making reference<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> to a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia (Kenobi and Skywalker)|mission on Cato Neimoidia]] from much earlier in the war.<ref name="Cover reveal">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-brotherhood-cover|text=Anakin and Obi-Wan Are Ready for Battle on the Cover of ''Star Wars: Brotherhood'' – Exclusive Reveal}}</ref>

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So, if you want to treat ''Labyrinth of Evil'' as "that business," nothing that happens in my book will negate that. They take place at two different points in the timeline, so they can totally co-exist. It's totally cool.|Mike Chen|<ref name="Chen interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.talkingbay94.com/2022/05/11/mike-chen-author-of-star-wars-brotherhood|text=Mike Chen: Author of Star Wars - BROTHERHOOD|accessdate=2022-05-12|work=''Talking Bay 94''|archivedate=20220511161716}}</ref>}}
The "[[Anakin Skywalker (reference book)|Anakin Skywalker]]" issue of ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that Skywalker claimed that he had saved Kenobi's life during the incident on Cato Neimoidia towards the end of the war,<ref name="Anakin Skywalker" /> explaining Skywalker's line in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] about saving Kenobi's life during "business on Cato Neimoidia."<ref name="ROTS" /> Within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the business was described in the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] seen in [[James Luceno]]'s novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''.<ref name="Chen interview" /> However, the [[canon]] novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]] later featured a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia (Kenobi and Skywalker)|mission to Cato Neimoidia]] from much earlier in the war said to be the "business" mentioned in ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="Cover reveal" /> Being a large fan of ''Labyrinth of Evil'', Chen made sure that his book did not contradict the other account, telling fans that they were free to continue to view ''Labyrinth of Evil'' as the business on Cato Neimoidia if they preferred.<ref name="Chen interview" />

The [[2017]] Japanese reference book ''[[Sutā Wōzu Batoru Taizen I EPISODE I・II・III]]'' had previously canonized details from the ''Labyrinth of Evil'' portrayal but stopped short of confirming the incident was what both Kenobi and Skywalker were making specific reference to in ''Revenge of the Sith'', instead suggesting only Kenobi and Skywalker themselves could understand what was being referenced between them in that moment.<ref name="BattleEncyclopedia" /> As such, this article reflects the ''Brotherhood'' mission as "that business on Cato Neimoidia" based on [[StarWars.com]] describing it as such,<ref name="Cover reveal" /> yet this article still reflects that Skywalker claimed to have saved Kenobi in the later battle based on Chen's comments and ''Sutā Wōzu Batoru Taizen I EPISODE I・II・III''.
